head_replacements.lib/stock.ex:
defmodule Stock do
  @moduledoc "Inbound stock feed. Each depot assigns its own receipt numbers."

  @doc "Count delivered units by depot, counting a retried receipt only once. Retries repeat the original row."
  def totals(receipts) do
    receipts
    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.receipt)
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn row, acc ->
      Map.update(acc, row.depot, row.units, &(&1 + row.units))
    end)
  end

  @doc "Return receipts in the closed date range; input order is preserved."
  def period(receipts, first, last) do
    Enum.filter(receipts, fn row ->
      in_period?(row.date, first, last)
    end)
  end

  defp in_period?(date, first, last) do
    Date.compare(date, first) != :lt and Date.before?(date, last)
  end
end
head_replacements.test/stock_test.exs:
defmodule StockTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "counts deliveries and filters the reporting period" do
    rows = [%{depot: :west, receipt: 4, units: 6, date: ~D[2026-01-15]}]
    assert Stock.totals(rows) == %{west: 6}
    assert Stock.period(rows, ~D[2026-01-01], ~D[2026-01-31]) == rows
  end
  test "redelivery does not inflate a depot total" do
    row = %{depot: :east, receipt: 78, units: 12, date: ~D[2026-03-18]}
    assert Stock.totals([row, row]) == %{east: 12}
  end
end
